title: Practice Interviews Like a Dress Rehearsal

sections.heading: An everyday analogy
sections.body:
Think of an interview like a school play. You would not go on stage without a dress rehearsal.

Pramp is like rehearsing with a classmate - you take turns acting and watching. Google Warmup is like practicing in front of a mirror that talks back about your voice. Exponent is like learning from former judges who show you how they score. InterviewBit is like a workbook with lessons in order.

sections.heading: Why it exists
sections.body:
Tech interviews test two things at once: solving problems and explaining them under pressure.

These tools exist to make that practice free and structured. Peer mock interviews mean live practice with another learner. FAANG interview frameworks mean step-by-step ways top companies expect you to answer. AI speech feedback means a computer checks your spoken answers. Structured coding prep means a planned path of coding problems, not random practice.

sections.heading: What can go wrong
sections.body:
Practice can fail if you use it wrong.

- Only memorizing answers: you freeze on new questions
- Only coding alone: you never learn to explain out loud
- Only watching videos: you do not get feedback on your own mistakes

Good prep mixes all four: do problems, say answers aloud, get feedback from peers and AI, and follow a plan.

steps.narration: Learn how interviewers score answers from ex-FAANG lessons.
Follow a structured path of coding problems in order.
Do a live peer mock to practice explaining under pressure.
Use AI to check your spoken clarity and filler words.
Bring the rehearsed skills to the real interview.

quiz.q: What is a peer mock interview?
options: Live practice where you and another learner interview each other
quiz.why: The save defines Pramp as matching you with peers for live mock coding sessions with instant feedback.

quiz.q: What fails first if you only memorize Exponent answers and never do Pramp or Warmup?
options: You will freeze when asked a new question out loud
quiz.why: Memorizing without live speaking practice means you can't adapt or explain under pressure.

quiz.q: Which tool gives AI speech feedback on common interview questions?
quiz.why: The save lists Google Warmup as the free AI tool for practicing common questions with voice feedback.
